name: Barlat Lakbour
body:
Barlat Lakbour
CR 6

This graceful woman is garbed in brightly colored and elaborately embroidered robes. Her arms and fingers are delicate but her nails are cracked and caked with dirt.

XP 2,400
NE Medium monstrous humanoid (shapechanger)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +6 natural)
hp 76 (9d10+27)
Fort +6, Ref +9, Will +9
Immune mind-affecting effects; SR 17

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +12 (2d8+1/19–20 plus nightmare claws), 1 hoof +12 (2d8+1)
Special Attacks bogeywoman, dream gluttony, push (hoof, 10 feet)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 9th; concentration +12)

At will—dancing lights, detect magic, detect thoughts (DC 15), disguise self, ray of enfeeblement (DC 14), silent image (DC 14)
3/day—deep slumber (DC 16), hypnotic pattern (DC 15), magic missile
1/day—dream, scrying (DC 17)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 16, Wis 17, Cha 17
Base Atk +9; CMB +10; CMD 24
Feats Improved Critical (claw), Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Bluff), Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +15, Knowledge (arcana, religion) +11, Perception +15, Sense Motive +10, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +13, Survival +13
Languages Common, Draconic, Sylvan
SQ change shape (humanoid woman or mule; alter self or beast shape I), ghoul friend

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bogeywoman (Su)

A barlat lakbour gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls against children, and children have a -2 penalty against spells and effects originating from the barlat lakbour. Any relative of a child taken by the barlat lakbour gains the shaken condition when confronting her.

Dream Gluttony (Su)

When a creature within 30 feet that the barlat lakbour can see regains consciousness (including awakening from sleep or being healed from negative hit points to positive hit points), as an immediate action she can try to drain their life force, dealing 2d10 points of negative energy damage (DC 17 Will negates).

If the target fails its save, the barlat lakbour gains temporary hit points equal to the hit points drained from the target, which last for 1 hour or until they are expended. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Ghoul Friend (Su)

Ghouls will not attack a barlat lakbour unless magically controlled. Ghouls always understand her and treat her requests in the most favorable terms.

Nightmare Claws (Su)

An unconscious creature struck by a barlat lakbour’s claws is affected by the nightmare spell (DC 17 Will negates). A creature that is awake is also affected by a nightmare (DC 17 Will negates) the next time they fall asleep if the barlat lakbour confirms a critical hit against them or causes them to fall unconscious, whether with a deep slumber spell or by reducing them to negative hit points.

ABOUT

These mystical women prowl the byways of cities and towns, making their habitation in graveyards and catacombs, the source of their nickname “mule of the graves.” They are shapechangers, able to take the form of a mule or adopt a humanoid form at need, and by night they assume a monstrous hybrid of the two.

They bury themselves in shallow graves when taking their rest, usually during the daytime.

Changing their appearance to adopt the guise of common women of the marketplace to observe the thoughts and dreams of people around them with their cunning mind. Sometimes they may put on a regal beauty bedecked in fine robes and jewels when the need suits them and they find a particularly choice target of wealth and taste. Once they have selected a victim, they assail their dreams by night, seeking to drive them to madness and despair as they feast on the psychic essence released by their torment.

The barlat lakbour has a particular savor for the misery caused by a missing child, and during her nightly prowls she seeks children who have stayed out too late to carry them off to their doom, using the child as a focus for her psychic powers.
